memory_candidates.content: In this repo, CONTRIBUTING.md's Table of Contents (lines 3-41) is hand-maintained, not auto-generated. Any new heading added anywhere in the file needs a matching manually-inserted anchor line in the ToC block, or the document becomes internally inconsistent (every existing heading has a ToC entry).

lake env lean <file> is unsafe for module-system files in cslib: it never passes --setup (which lake build always does), so Lean 4.33's module/public import exposure configuration is absent and elaboration can diverge with no diagnostic. It also bypasses dependency resolution (consumes stale .oleans) and never writes an .olean without -o, so a missing .olean after such a run is not evidence the module has never built. Correct check: lake build <Module.Name>; if raw lean output is needed, lake env lean --setup <module>.setup.json <file> (setup.json lives under .lake/build/ir/...).
